original: HyperOS OS3.0.335.0.XPCMIXM matched stock miui-services.jar + framework-ext-res.apk
core: 30 original smali classes; namespace relocation only. Includes DualSensorPolicy, AmbientLightRingBuffer, HysteresisLevelsImpl, SceneDetector and AON Binder interfaces. Original branches, constants and scheduling retained.

polling_authorization: User explicitly chose original internal scheduling after proposed event-only rewrite; exception limited to original brightness policy.
